article.title: пере- re-/exceso
article.part: Partículas y prefijación — Частицы и приставки
article.chapter: Prefijación aspectual y significado léxico — Видовые приставки и лексическое значение

claims.summary: The Russian prefix 'пере-' can convey two main meanings: repetition (doing something anew) and excess (going beyond an appropriate limit). Its interpretation depends on the full verb.

With some verbs, 'пере-' indicates repeated or rehearsed actions (e.g., перечитать = read again, переписать = rewrite, copy anew). With others, it denotes exceeding a limit (e.g., пересолить = add too much salt, перегреть = overheat, передержать = leave too long).

Examples illustrate both meanings of 'пере-': 'Я перечитал статью вечером' (I re-read the article in the evening) shows repetition, while 'Повар пересолил суп' (The cook added too much salt to the soup) demonstrates excess.

Beyond repetition and excess, 'пере-' can also denote spatial crossing or passing (e.g., перейти улицу = cross the street, переехать реку = cross a river). Some verbs develop lexical meanings distinct from simple addition of 're-', 'too much', or 'across'.
